title: Making an API Call in Postman

blocks.text: Before making API calls, ensure that the API is authenticated.

blocks.item: If you are using an environment to reference your variables, select the appropriate environment configured for OneAPI from the environment drop-down menu in the top-right corner of the Postman UI.
To access specific coding language scripts, go to the request for which you need the script and click the Code icon in the toolbar. Select the desired language from the drop-down menu.
